proof_scope: Tau core local DAG execution and tamper-evident ledger proof

claims.proves: Tau can execute a live local creator/reviewer DAG through its CLI and verify the resulting tamper-evident run ledger with independent readbacks.
claims.does_not_prove: provider semantic quality, browser rendering quality, GitHub mutation behavior, or full product readiness.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau executes a local goal-bound DAG through the CLI, writes a ledger, verifies it intact, and rejects tampering.

cases.name: live-local-dag-ledger-tamper-proof
argv: cd .. && uv run python scripts/agentic-eval-tau-core-proof.py --out local/agentic-evals/tau-core-proof.json
